name: Neurok
description: Tribes on the shores of the Quicksilver Sea enslaved by the vedalken, who later forced cooperation after revolts.

timeline.summary: Memnarch destroys the Neurok settlement of Medev.
timeline.quote: Medev was a prominent Neurok settlement until its destruction by the planar caretaker Memnarch .

citation.text: "Neurok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Vanishing, the Synod claims all serum and the Neurok form secret networks to undermine the Vedalken.
timeline.quote: They began to form secret sects to undermine the Vedalken.

citation.text: "Neurok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Neurok use the Litera Phials to learn how to destroy vedalken drones.
timeline.quote: even learning the secret to destroy a key vedalken weapon

citation.text: "Neurok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of the Synod the Neurok power down the vedalken drones and defeat the Synod.
timeline.quote: The Synod was defeated, but hundreds died on both sides.

timeline.summary: Neurok and Vedalken leaders agree to an uneasy truce.
timeline.quote: Leaders between the Neurok and the Vedalken reached an uneasy truce.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's fall, the Synod reorganizes the vedalken into sanctives, and Neurok revolts force cooperation.
timeline.quote: revolts from the Neurok forced the two races into a state of cooperation rather than subservience
